description: One Shopify store connection. A single-store bench has exactly one, named 'default'; a multi-tenant bench has one per seller. Holds the store's credentials, its Alaiy OS defaults, and its sync settings.

fields.label: Connection ID
fields.description: Stable id used by callers and by the app that manages this store. A bench upgraded from the single-connection version keeps its one connection as 'default'.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Human-readable name, e.g. the store or brand.

fields.label: Default Connection
fields.description: Used when a caller names no connection. A bench with exactly one connection does not need this set.

fields.label: Created By App
fields.description: Set by whichever app created this connection, so a multi-tenant bench can tell its own rows from ones made by hand.
Your Shopify store domain, e.g. myshop.myshopify.com
fields.label: Shop URL

fields.description: Client ID from your Shopify custom app (Developer Dashboard)
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: Client Secret from your Shopify custom app
fields.label: Client Secret

fields.description: Access token (auto-managed by Test Connection)
fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: When the current access token was last minted.
fields.label: Token Refreshed At

fields.description: When the current access token expires, per Shopify's own expires_in. Client credentials tokens are short-lived (observed ~24h) — the scheduled refresh below keeps this from ever being hit.
fields.label: Token Expires At

fields.description: Shared secret used to validate the X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 header on incoming webhooks. Must match the secret configured on the Shopify webhook subscriptions. Required: webhooks are rejected outright if this isn't set, rather than silently accepted unverified.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Warehouse for fulfilling Shopify orders
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Where a Shopify refund's Sales Return lands. Leave blank to use Default Warehouse instead -- someone downstream (e.g. a supplier portal's own returns routing) decides where it really ends up from there.
fields.label: Return Warehouse

fields.description: Territory assigned to Customers auto-created from Shopify orders. Falls back to any existing Territory if left blank -- there's no guarantee a site has one named 'All Territories'.
fields.label: Default Territory

fields.description: Account that tax lines pulled from Shopify orders (e.g. CGST, SGST, VAT) are booked against. Leave blank to auto-resolve/create a 'Shopify Tax' account under the company.
fields.label: Tax Account

fields.description: Auto-create + submit a Sales Invoice for Shopify orders. Submitting that invoice in Alaiy OS also marks the order Paid on Shopify.
fields.label: Auto-create Sales Invoice

fields.description: When to generate the invoice. 'Paid and Fulfilled' (recommended) waits for both payment and shipment -- correct for Cash on Delivery, where payment lands only on delivery. 'Paid' invoices as soon as the order is paid.
fields.label: Generate Invoice When

fields.description: Map Alaiy OS warehouses to Shopify locations for multi-location inventory sync. Run 'Sync Locations' first to load Shopify locations. Leave empty to push only the Default Warehouse to Shopify's primary location (single-location mode).
fields.label: Warehouse to Location Map

fields.description: Filter for which orders to pull from Shopify
fields.label: Sync Orders With Status

fields.description: Direction fulfillment sync runs in. 'Shopify → Alaiy OS' (default): a Shopify fulfillment auto-creates a submitted Delivery Note here -- today's only behavior, unchanged when left at default. 'Alaiy OS → Shopify (two-way)': in addition, submitting a Delivery Note here (e.g. a warehouse scanning items out against a Sales Order) creates a real Shopify fulfillment with tracking info. Safe to switch either way at any time -- no reinstall needed.
fields.label: Fulfillment Sync Direction
fields.options:
Shopify → Alaiy OS (default)
Alaiy OS → Shopify (two-way)

fields.description: How often to push Alaiy OS stock levels to Shopify
fields.label: Inventory Sync Interval

fields.description: How often to proactively mint a fresh access token, so a sync never has to hit an expired-token error first. Shopify's client_credentials tokens for this app were observed to last ~24h.
fields.label: Token Refresh Interval

fields.description: Unticking a status excludes it from Import Products entirely -- those products are counted as skipped, not created.
fields.label: Import Active products

fields.description: Archived products are hidden from Shopify's sales channels but keep their order history.
fields.label: Import Archived products

fields.description: Pushing an archived product unarchives it to Draft for the update, then archives it again.
fields.label: Export Archived products

name: Shopify Connection
